// diagnostic

E3103

`{fn}` is an `#Unsafe` function.

What

`{fn}` is an `#Unsafe` function.

Why

Its contract can't be checked by the compiler, so the caller must vouch for it.

Fix

Call it inside `#Unsafe("…") { … }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3103: tests/ui/cffi_out_pointer_requires_unsafe.stderr.

    |            ^^^^^^
 Why: its contract can't be checked by the compiler, so the caller must vouch for it
 Fix: call it inside `#Unsafe("…") { … }`
